propositions: Production in-process verifier exhibits false-FAIL verdicts and evidence-sufficiency classification unreliability attributed to harness scaffolding (step budget, structured tool surface, output contracts) rather than the verification task itself.

Minimal free-tool harness agent (Copilot CLI with grep/read/test freedom) receives only AC list and worktree path, with INSUFFICIENT as mandatory abstain state for unreachable claims, to isolate verification-task reliability from rebar framework overhead.
Arm B must achieve zero false-PASS on planted-unmet ACs and total rejections strictly less than Arm A to meet GO decision criterion.
Arm B harness errors (parse failures, missing ACs, crashes) are counted as INSUFFICIENT rejections to enforce fail-closed behavior and reflect production coverage requirements.
Decision rule predeclared: GO iff (i) Arm B false-PASS=0, (ii) Arm B rejections < Arm A rejections, (iii) Arm B wall time ≤ 2× Arm A; applied verbatim with arithmetic shown.
